name: PlugMCP Directory
description: Searches the PlugMCP directory of MCP servers and agent skills, recommends servers for a task, compares them side by side, and returns install configs for clients like Cursor, Claude Code and VS Code. Read-only; an API key is optional and only raises rate limits.

PLUGMCP_API_KEY.description: Optional pb_live_ key from https://plugmcp.ai/app for higher rate limits.
